text:
ana: Heads-up — multiple reports about JS SDK differences across runtimes: Node (undici) vs edge (global fetch) vs bundlers. Also TS CJS interop/type issues. Anyone seen this?
sam: yup. Two buckets: fetch runtime detection/fallback and ESM/CJS export shape + types.
mike: need a tiny repro to know if it's an import error or missing API.
nana: repro from user on Cloudflare Workers:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood-sdk'
addEventListener('fetch', e => {
  const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: SECRET })
  e.respondWith(c.chat.generate({ prompt: 'hi' }))
})
```
They hit `TypeError: fetch is not a function` because our SDK tries `const f = globalThis.fetch ?? (await import('undici')).fetch` and bundlers/edge builds hoist or rewrite dynamic imports.
sam: root cause: guarded dynamic import is getting bundled or CJS consumers get different export shapes (`require()` gives default wrapper). Also some bundlers polyfill fetch weirdly.
julie: support also reported auth header lost after 302 redirects under undici; our retry wrapper replays requests without headers on redirect.
sam: proposed plan: 1) prefer globalThis.fetch if present; 2) fallback to dynamic undici import only in Node; 3) make undici optional peer dep; 4) ship small runtime helper that bundlers won't hoist.
mike: implementation note: avoid top-level require('undici'). Use runtime guard: if (!globalThis.fetch && process?.versions?.node) await import('undici') and bind fetch. Throw clear error instructing `npm i undici` if missing.
(suggested helper) `export async function getFetch(){ if(typeof globalThis.fetch==='function')return globalThis.fetch; if(typeof process!=='undefined'&&process.versions?.node){ try{ const u=await import('undici'); return u.fetch.bind(u);}catch{throw new Error('redwood-sdk requires a fetch implementation. install undici or provide globalThis.fetch')} } throw new Error('no fetch available') }`
sam: that pattern avoids bundling undici into edge builds. For CJS/TS: ensure package.json `exports` maps ESM and CJS correctly, ship .d.ts and set `types` field. Document `import RedwoodClient from 'redwood-sdk'` vs `const { RedwoodClient } = require('redwood-sdk')`.
nana: TS issue: users with `esModuleInterop:false` saw `any` types. We should generate typings that reference both default and named exports and add `declare module` shims if needed.
julie: edge quirks: Cloudflare Workers variants accept `(request, env, ctx)`; our wrapper should accept `(input, init)` and examples note Worker handler patterns.
mike: retry/auth: streaming bodies can't be replayed; either buffer small bodies for retries or document `retry: false` for streams. For redirects, set `redirect:'manual'` and implement follow logic that preserves Authorization headers if safe. Add tests to ensure 302 doesn't drop headers in our path.
sam: action items: sam -> draft runtime-fetch helper + tests; ana -> update package.json exports & README CJS/ESM guidance; julie -> add Workers to CI matrix; mike -> write redirect/retry tests.
ci-bot: branch `sdk/fetch-fallback` created. CI will run Workers e2e after tests.
nana: I'll patch quickstart with "Edge runtimes: don't install undici; Node <18: install undici" and add FAQ entry for "SDK says fetch missing" with snippet and `npm i undici` guidance.
sam: opening draft PR today. mike/julie please review tests.
mike: on it.
julie: will add CI job.
nana: closing — small changelog blurb for SDK about fetch behavior + undici optional peer dep please. :white_check_mark:
